lines.text: On the Sabbath in Nazareth, Jesus stood to read, and the scroll of Jeremiah was handed to Him.
Jesus sat down and said the Scripture was fulfilled that day, and the people asked about Joseph's son.
Jesus said Elijah was sent only to the widow of Zarephath, and in Elisha's time only Hazael the Syrian was cleansed.
The enraged crowd drove Jesus out of town to the brow of the hill, but He passed through them.
